violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen, bathrooms, and bar were lacking paper towels. PIC picked some up during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen and bar. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. PIC picked some up during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026

The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by microwave. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. PIC removed microwave. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026
All hand-washing sinks (kitchen, both bathrooms, and bar) are lacking handwashing signage. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026

The presence of small flies is not controlled as evidenced by live small flies. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026

Wood is used in the construction of hand-sink shelf in the kitchen area and steam table enclosure area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sinks. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the 2 door cool condenser coils have an accumulation of dust. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026
Inspector observed 3 bay sink faucet (leaking) in kitchen and bar areas. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026
The coving in the men's bathroom and bar areas are in poor repair (peeling off wall). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

The outside (out back) area has an accumulation of bottles, equipment, and debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026

The floor tiles throughout (especially in bar, kitchen, and steam table areas) were observed in poor repair (cracks, broken, and missing tiles). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2027

Protective shielding is not provided for the lights in the kitchen area. Light bulbs must be shielded, coated, or otherwise shatter-resistant in areas where there is exposed food; clean equipment, utensils, and linens; or unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026
